subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 7: Skills – Reading: a science blog
outcomes: I can predict what a text is about from its title and match headings to paragraphs.
I can find facts about the history of cardboard in a science blog.
I can explain why cardboard with triangles is strong.

tf.s: The text is a science blog.
tf.why: Yes! It's Majid's science blog about cardboard.

tf.s: Robert Gair invented the cardboard box.
tf.why: Right! He was a Scottish engineer.

tf.s: The first cardboard box was in 1906.
tf.why: The first cardboard box was in 1879.

tf.s: Robert Gair was a doctor from Oman.
The triangle is the strongest shape.
tf.why: Yes! It can carry a lot.

tf.s: A house of cards works better with squares than with triangles.
tf.why: It works with triangles but not with squares.

tf.s: In 1906, a food company put a name and a picture on a cereal box.
tf.why: Yes! That happened for the first time in 1906.

tf.s: We can see triangle shapes in bridges and bikes.
An engineer is a person who sells food.
tf.why: An engineer designs and builds things.

tf.s: Paragraph 2 of the blog is about cardboard in space.
tf.why: Paragraph 2 is the History of cardboard.

boxes.q: When did Robert Gair invent the cardboard box?
What happened for the first time in 1906?
o: a cereal box with a name and a picture
boxes.why: A food company put the name and a picture on a cereal box.

boxes.q: To make something new for the first time is to ___.
boxes.why: Robert Gair invented the cardboard box.

boxes.q: What is a cereal box made of?
boxes.why: Cereal boxes are made of cardboard.

boxes.q: Not weak, it can carry a lot: it's ___.
boxes.why: Strong things can carry a lot.

hunt.q: The first cereal box picture: year
A shape with four equal sides
Box with a food name and picture

mcq.why: He was a Scottish engineer who invented the cardboard box.

mcq.q: Which words are from the blog?
mcq.why: These are the science blog words.

o: Robert Gair invented the cardboard box.
The first cereal box with a picture.
mcq.why: 1879 is the year of the first cardboard box.

mcq.q: What can we do before reading a text?
o: Predict what it is about from the title.

mcq.q: Name three places where you can see triangle shapes.
o: the sun, the moon, a CD

mcq.q: Describe a cardboard object at home. Which sentence is best?
o: This is a cereal box. We keep our breakfast in it.
This is a glass. I drink water from it.
This is a phone. I call my friend.
This is a pen. I write with it.
mcq.why: A cereal box is made of cardboard.

mcq.q: You build one card shape with triangles and one with squares. What happens?
o: The triangle shape stands; the square one falls.
The square shape stands; the triangle one falls.

mcq.q: Why does a house of cards work with triangles but not with squares?
o: The triangle is the strongest shape; it can carry a lot.
mcq.why: Triangles stay strong and keep their shape.

mcq.q: How many years after the first cardboard box was the first cereal box with a picture?
A paragraph tells us about 1879 and 1906. Which heading fits it best?
mcq.why: Years and first inventions are history.
